How to use

Pick a viewSelect a smaller camera to bring it forward. Single shows just that camera.

Choose your soundSound follows the main camera. Tap the speaker to unmute. Some broadcasts may be silent.

Stay up to dateGo live catches up after a pause. Returning to this tab catches up automatically while playing.

Watch while browsingPicture in picture opens the main video in a floating window, where supported.

Live channelOpen the configured channel. Its on-air status is not checked automatically.

Space Play / pause · M Sound · F Full screen

Connection

Measured on this device. Streamview sends no analytics or diagnostic reports. Hosting and video providers still receive requests, including your IP address.

About this project

Streamview is a streaming-player template. No broadcasts or playback credentials are included.

Connect only sources you are authorized to use. Settings delivered to a browser are visible to its visitors.

Connection details stay on this device unless copied. Hosting and video providers receive ordinary requests, including connection IP addresses.
